name: HEALTHBANE Campaign - ATT&CK Observed and Inferred Techniques
description: HEALTHBANE campaign mapping. OBSERVED techniques are scored 100; HC3-likely but unconfirmed techniques are scored 50.

techniques.comment: OBSERVED: HC3 reports email-identity gathering as part of campaign targeting. Phase: pre-Stage 1 reconnaissance. Source: HC3 advisory.
OBSERVED: lookalike healthcare domains were acquired shortly before phishing. Phase: pre-Stage 1 infrastructure. Sources: HC3 and MedDefense.
OBSERVED: healthcare-themed sender identities and attacker-controlled mail infrastructure were used. Phase: Stage 1. Sources: HC3, researcher, MedDefense.
OBSERVED: HC3 reports the macro document, executable, RAT behavior, and PowerShell tooling. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: credential-capture pages were staged at healthcare-themed URLs. Phase: Stage 1. Sources: HC3, researcher, MedDefense.
OBSERVED: spearphishing links delivered credential-capture pages; a MedDefense user clicked. Phase: Stage 1. Sources: HC3 and MedDefense.
OBSERVED: compromised accounts sent follow-up emails with a macro-enabled DOCM attachment. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3.

INFERRED: HC3 assesses compromised credentials and cloud-email authentication as likely but excludes Valid Accounts from its observed table pending confirmation. Phase: Stage 1 to Stage 2 transition. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: a MedDefense nurse clicked the phishing link. Phase: Stage 1. Sources: HC3 and MedDefense.
OBSERVED: users opened the macro-enabled follow-up document in affected organizations. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: the DOCM macro executed VBA to retrieve the Windows payload. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3 sandbox and partner evidence.
OBSERVED: PowerShell execution and sync_healthdata.ps1 were reported. Phase: Stage 2. Sources: HC3, Acme, researcher.
OBSERVED: the executable created the HealthSync Update Service scheduled task. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: persistence was established with a Registry Run key. Phase: Stage 2. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: PHP form handlers captured usernames and passwords. Phase: Stage 1. Sources: HC3, researcher, MedDefense.
OBSERVED: DNS TXT queries carried C2 and exfiltration traffic. Phase: Stage 3. Sources: HC3 packet captures and Acme.
OBSERVED: HTTP/HTTPS endpoints served phishing forms and malware downloads. Phases: Stages 1-2. Sources: HC3, researcher, MedDefense.
INFERRED: HC3 assesses Remote Services as likely in follow-on activity but excludes it pending confirmation. Phase: Stage 2 lateral movement. Source: HC3.
OBSERVED: patient and insurance data were encoded into DNS labels and sent through TXT queries. Phase: Stage 3. Source: HC3 packet captures.
OBSERVED: exfiltration used attacker-controlled C2 infrastructure; the researcher also recovered an EXFIL_ENDPOINT. Phase: Stage 3. Sources: HC3 and researcher.
